profile.headline: Software Engineer passionate about Personal Finance
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with a passion for Personal Finance. 

Bilingual (English 🇺🇸  & Spanish 🇻🇪) Ramsey Certified Financial Coach and Financial Peace University Coordinator.

Let your gentleness be evident to all! ✌😉

company.name: Ramsey Solutions, A Dave Ramsey Company

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed functionality for GO by Spark Labs. 
• Tech Stack: React, Babel, MongoDB, TypeScript, JavaScript ES6, Git, BitBucket, Jira.

positions.title: IT / Web / Programming Manager
positions.description:
• Wordpress websites administration; hosting, content & plugins updates, backups. 
• Migration to Planning Center Church Management System from Elvanto.
• iOS and Android Mobile App administration & events registrations (PushPay platform).
• Assist to leadership and technical conferences.
• Training, supervise and create incentives for volunteers.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Conduct research in the area of Operating Systems and Storage Systems.
• Design, implement and evaluate new capabilities for storage systems and filesystems.
• Develop instrumentation for the Linux kernel.
• Co-author of technical research papers and assist to industry and academy conferences.

positions.title: Systems, Processes and Capabilities Intern
positions.description:
• Administration of Product Safety & Regulatory Affairs Department collaboration website over Microsoft SharePoint Platform. Regional scale (Latin America).
• Database design of Regulatory Planning & Tracking information system to manage LA PS&RA projects. Regional scale (Latin America).
• Training and Technical Support to Latin America Product Safety & Regulatory Affairs team members.

positions.title: Laboratorio Docente de Computación - Systems Administrator
positions.description:
• Administration and maintenance of a large amount of networked GNU/Linux and Windows machines, computer architectures x86, amd64 and SPARC.
• Massive Debian installation in a large amount of machines via FAI servers administration and maintenance.
• Administration of mail, DNS, web (Apache http and Tomcat), LDAP, printing, ﬁrewall, NTP, NFS, DHCP, Bacula and Nagios services.

honors.title: Koala IM+IN Award
honors.issuer: Issued by Product Engineering Team · Dec 2020

honors.description:
